BiblicalUsage: Nethan-melech is a chamberlain in the house of the LORD, and his name survives because Josiah's reform reaches his chamber. The horses the kings of Judah gave to the sun stand by his room, and Josiah takes them away and burns the chariots of the sun with fire.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Josiah's reform is thorough because it reaches the chamberlain's door — even the sun's horses by the temple are taken away.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
